extracted.intended_audience: classification officers, patent/trademark/design applicants and examiners who must assign goods to classes/subclasses
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and class-by-class explanatory notes for assigning goods to the correct class and subclass in a formal goods classification list. Includes numbering/formatting conventions, general notes, and for each class the inclusions/exclusions and example subclasses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class and subclass numbering/formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Class numbers are indicated in Arabic figures; the subclass number is also indicated in Arabic figures, but it must always contain two digits; for the subclasses, therefore, the numbers 1 to 9 will be preceded by an 0; the class number is separated from the subclass number by a dash (for instance, Class 1 Subclass 4 will be indicated thus: 1-04).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The class and subclass numbers will be preceded by the indication "Cl." (for instance: Cl. 1-04). If the numbers of several classes or subclasses must be indicated for one and the same deposit, the classes should be separated by a semicolon and the subclasses by a comma (for instance: Cl. 8-05, 08; 11-01).

rubrics_metrics.name: General note on class/subclass notes
rubrics_metrics.description: The notes relating to a class are not repeated in the subclasses which they concern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is advisable, therefore, to consult class notes at the same time as the notes on the subclasses themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 1 - Foodstuffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Includes foodstuffs for human beings, foodstuffs for animals and dietetic foods. (b) Not including packages (Class 9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 1-01 Bakery products, biscuits, pastry, macaroni and other cereal products, chocolates, confectionery, ices; 1-02 Fruit and vegetables; 1-03 Cheeses, butter and butter substitutes, other dairy produce; 1-04 Butcher's meat (including pork products), fish; 1-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 2 - Articles of Clothing and Haberdashery
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Including articles of clothing for dolls. (b) Not including special equipment for protection against fire hazards, for accident prevention and for rescue (Class 29), or animal clothing (Class 30-01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses and notes: 2-01 Undergarments, lingerie, corsets, brassieres, nightwear (including orthopedic corsets and body linen; not including household linen Class 6-13); 2-02 Garments (includes all sorts of garments subject to exceptions; not undergarments or garments placed in 2-03–2-06); 2-03 Headwear; 2-04 Footwear, socks and stockings; 2-05 Neckties, scarves and handkerchiefs; 2-06 Gloves; 2-07 Haberdashery and clothing accessories (including buttons, clasps; not including yarns Class 5-01 or decorative trimmings Class 5-04); 2-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 3 - Travel Goods, Cases, Parasols and Personal Belongings, Not Elsewhere Specified
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers trunks, suitcases, briefcases, handbags, wallets and similar articles; cases specially designed for their contents; umbrellas, parasols, sunshades and walking sticks; fans; miscellaneous personal articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 3-01 Not including cases specially designed for their contents (Class 3-02), objects used for transporting goods (Class 9), or cigar/cigarette cases (Class 27-06). 3-02 Cases specially designed for their contents (not including packages Class 9). 3-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 4 - Brushware
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes brushes and brooms for cleaning, toilet brushes and clothes brushes, brushes for machines, paintbrushes and brushes for use in cooking and miscellaneous brushware.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 4-01 Not including clothes brushes (Class 4-02). 4-02 "Toilet brushes" means brushes for corporal use (hair, nails, teeth). 4-03 "Brushes for machines" means brushes incorporated in machines or special vehicles. 4-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 5 - Textile Piecegood Articles, Artificial and Natural Sheet Material
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Includes all textile or similar articles, sold by the yard and not made up. (b) Not including ready-made articles (Classes 2 or 6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 5-01 Spa articles (including yarn and thread; not including rope, wire rope, string, twine Class 9-06); 5-02 Lace; 5-03 Embroidery; 5-04 Ribbons, braids and other decorative trimmings; 5-05 Textile fabrics (woven, knitted or otherwise); 5-06 Artificial or natural sheet material (including sheets whose only characteristics are surface ornamentation or texture, e.g., wallpaper, linoleum, self-adhesive plastic sheets, wrapping sheets; not including writing paper Class 19-01 or sheets used as building components Class 25-01); 5-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 6 - Furnishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Composite furniture articles embodying components included in several subclasses are classified in 6-05. (b) Not including textile piecegood articles (Class 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 6-01 Beds and seats (including mattress supports and vehicle seats); 6-03 Tables and similar furniture; 6-04 Storage furniture (cupboards, furniture with drawers, shelves); 6-05 Composite furniture; 6-07 Mirrors and frames (not including mirrors included in other classes — see alphabetical list); 6-09 Mattresses and cushions; 6-10 Curtains and indoor blinds; 6-11 Carpets, mats and rugs; 6-12 Tapestries; 6-13 Blankets and other covering materials, household linen and napery (including furniture covers, bedspreads and table covers); 6-99 Miscellaneous. Note: 6-02 is vacant. N.B.: the French text contains a note which does not concern the English text (re 6-08 Clothes hangers).

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 7 - Household Goods, Not Elsewhere Specified
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes household appliances and utensils operated by hand, even if motor driven.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 7-01 China, glassware, dishes and similar articles (includes dishes and crockery in all materials, including paper and cardboard; not including cooking utensils and containers Class 7-02 or purely ornamental items Class 11-02); 7-02 Cooking appliances, utensils and containers; 7-03 Table knives, forks and spoons; 7-04 Appliances and utensils for preparing food or drink (not including appliances classified in 7-02); 7-05 Flatirons and washing, cleaning and drying equipment (not including electric household appliances for washing etc. Class 15-05); 7-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 8 - Tools and Hardware
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Includes hand-operated tools, even if mechanical power takes the place of muscular force (e.g., electric saws and drills). (b) Not including machines or machine tools (Class 15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 8-01 Tools and implements for drilling, milling or digging; 8-02 Hammers and similar tools; 8-03 Cutting tools and implements (including tools for sawing; not including table knives Class 7-03, kitchen cutting tools Class 7-04, or surgical knives Class 24-02); 8-04 Screwdrivers; 8-05 Other tools and implements; 8-06 Handles, knobs and hinges; 8-07 Locking or closing devices; 8-08 Fastening, supporting or mounting devices not included in other classes (including nails, screws, nuts and bolts; not including fastening devices for clothing Class 2-07, for adornment Class 11-01, or for office use Class 19-02); 8-09 Metal fittings and mountings for doors, windows and furniture; 8-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 9 - Packages and Containers for the Transport or Handling of Goods
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers bottles, flasks, pots, carboys and containers with dispensing means; storage cans, drums and casks; boxes, cases, containers and tins; hampers, crates and baskets; bags, sachets, tubes and capsules; ropes and hooping materials; closing means and attachments; and miscellaneous packaging articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 9-01 'Pots' means those serving as containers; not including pots regarded as crockery Class 7-01 or flower pots Class 11-02. 9-03 includes freight containers. 9-05 includes plastic bags with or without handles or means of closing; 'capsules' means those used for packaging. 9-07 includes only closing means for packages; 'attachments' include dispensing/dosing devices incorporated in containers and detachable atomizers. 9-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 10 - Clocks and Watches and Other Measuring Instruments, Checking and Signalling Instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Including electrically-driven instruments: clocks, alarm clocks, watches, other time-measuring instruments (parking meters, timers), measuring instruments for temperature/pressure/weight/length/volume/electricity (excluding exposure meters Class 16-05), checking/security/testing instruments (fire and burglar alarms, detectors), signalling apparatus, casings and parts and accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 10-04 excludes exposure meters (Class 16-05). 10-05 includes fire and burglar alarms. 10-06 signalling apparatus excludes vehicle lighting/signalling devices Class 26-06. 10-07 'casings' excludes cases specially designed for their contents (Class 3-02) or for packaging (Class 9-03). 10-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 11 - Articles of Adornment
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes jewelry (including fancy and imitation jewelry), trinkets, table/mantel/wall ornaments, flower vases and pots (including sculptures, mobiles and statues), medals and badges, artificial flowers, flags and festive decorations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 11-01 Not including watches (Class 10-02). 11-05 festive decorations include garlands, streamers and Christmas tree decorations. 11-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 12 - Means of Transport or Hoisting
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Includes all vehicles: land, sea, air, space and others. (b) Including parts, components and accessories which exist only in connection with a vehicle and cannot be placed in another class; such parts are to be placed in the vehicle's subclass or in Class 12-16 if common to vehicles of different subclasses. (c) Parts which can be placed in another class should be placed there (e.g., carpets Class 6-11; electric motors Class 13-01; non-electric motors Class 15-01). (d) Not including scale models of vehicles (Class 21-01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 12-01 Vehicles drawn by animals; 12-03 Locomotives and rolling stock; 12-05 Elevators and hoists for loading or conveying (including passenger lifts, goods lifts, cranes, forklift trucks and conveyor belts); 12-06 Ships and boats; 12-07 Aircraft and space vehicles; 12-08 Motor cars, buses and lorries (including ambulances and refrigerator vans); 12-16 Other parts, equipment and accessories for vehicles not elsewhere specified; 12-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 13 - Equipment for Production, Distribution or Transformation of Electricity
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Includes only apparatus which produces, distributes or transforms electric current. (b) Including electric motors. (c) Not including electrically-driven apparatus (Class 10-02) or apparatus for measurement of electric current (Class 10-04).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example subclasses: 13-01 Generators and motors (including electric motors for vehicles); 13-02 Power transformers, rectifiers, batteries and accumulators; 13-03 Equipment for distribution or control of electric power (including conductors, switches and switchboards); 13-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 14 - Recording, Communication or Information Retrieval Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment for recording or reproduction of sounds or pictures (not including photographic or cinematographic apparatus Class 16); equipment for recording, reproduction or retrieval of information (including computers and other data processing equipment; not including photographic reproduction apparatus Class 16 or printing equipment Class 18); communications equipment and radio amplifiers (including telegraphic, telephone and television apparatus, television cameras, wireless apparatus and teleprinters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 14-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15 - Machines, Not Elsewhere Specified
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers non-electric engines (including non-electric motors for vehicles), pumps and compressors, agricultural machinery, construction machinery (machines used in civil engineering and self-propelled machines such as excavators and concrete mixers), washing/cleaning/drying machines, textile/sewing/knitting/embroidering machines, refrigeration machinery and apparatus, machines for preparing food and drink (not including cooking appliances Class 7-02), material working/abrading/founding machinery, and miscellaneous machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 15-02 excludes hand or foot pumps Class 8-05 and fire extinguishing pumps Class 29-01. 15-03 agricultural machinery not including hand tools (Class 8). 15-05 includes appliances/machines for treating linen and clothes (ironing machines, wringers) and dish washing machines/industrial drying equipment. 15-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16 - Photographic, Cinematographic and Optical Apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes photographic cameras and film cameras, projectors, photocopying apparatus and enlargers (including microfilming equipment and office 'photocopying' apparatus using non-photographic processes), developing apparatus and equipment, accessories (filters, exposure meters, tripods and photographic flash apparatus), and optical articles (spectacles and microscopes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 16-06 Optical articles not including measuring instruments embodying optical devices (Class 10-04). 16-99 Miscellaneous. 16-05 Accessories includes exposure meters (distinct from 10-04).

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17 - Musical Instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes keyboard instruments (electronic organs, accordions, pianos), wind instruments (not including organs, harmoniums and accordions Class 17-01), stringed instruments, percussion instruments, mechanical instruments (music boxes; not including mechanical keyboard instruments Class 17-01) and miscellaneous musical instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 17-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 18 - Printing and Office Machinery
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes typewriters and calculating machines (not including computers Class 14-02), printing machines (typesetting machines, stereotype machines, typographic machines and similar reproducing machines; not including photocopying machinery Class 16-03), type and type faces, bookbinding machines, printers' stapling machines, guillotines and trimmers and related equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 18-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 19 - Stationery and Office Equipment, Artists' and Teaching Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes writing paper (all paper used for writing, drawing, painting or printing such as tracing paper, carbon paper, newsprint and envelopes), office equipment (including equipment used at cash desks, change sorters), calendars (not including diaries Class 19-04), books and similar objects (covers, bindings, albums, diaries), cards for correspondence and announcements, materials and instruments for writing/drawing/painting/sculpture/engraving and teaching materials (including maps, globes and planetariums; not including audio-visual teaching aids Class 14-01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 19-08 Other printed matter includes printed advertising materials. Notes indicate some office equipment belongs in other classes (office furniture Class 6, office machines Class 14/16/18). 19-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 20 - Sales and Advertising Equipment, Signs
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes automatic vending machines, display and sales equipment (not including articles of furniture Class 6), signs, signboards and advertising devices (including luminous and mobile advertising devices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 20-03 Signs and advertising devices not including packages Class 9 or signalling devices Class 10-06. 20-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 21 - Games, Toys, Tents and Sports Goods
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes games and toys (including scale models), gymnastics and sports apparatus and equipment (sports equipment necessary for a sport, excluding other multi-use objects), other amusement and entertainment articles (including fairground roundabouts and automatic machines for games of chance), tents and accessories (poles, pegs etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 21-02 includes training equipment and outdoor equipment subject to reservations; sports clothing belongs to Class 2; toboggans or sleighs Class 12-14. 21-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 22 - Arms, Pyrotechnic Articles, Articles for Hunting, Fishing and Pest Killing
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes projectile weapons, other weapons, ammunition/rockets/pyrotechnic articles, bullets and accessories (including devices for actuating mobile targets), hunting and fishing equipment (not including clothing Class 2), traps and articles for pest killing and miscellaneous items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 22-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 23 - Fluid Distribution Equipment, Sanitary, Heating, Ventilation and Air-Conditioning Equipment, Solid Fuel
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes fluid distribution equipment (pipes and pipe fittings), sanitary appliances (baths, showers, washbasins, saunas, water closets and sanitary units; not including pipes/pipe fittings Class 23-01), heating equipment, ventilation and air-conditioning equipment, solid fuel and miscellaneous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 23-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 24 - Medical and Laboratory Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: The term 'medical equipment' covers also surgical, dental and veterinary equipment. Includes fixed apparatus and equipment for doctors, hospitals and laboratories; medical instruments and tools for laboratory use (only hand-operated instruments); prosthetic articles; materials for dressing wounds, nursing and medical care; and miscellaneous medical/laboratory items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 24-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 25 - Building Units and Construction Elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes building materials (bricks, beams, pre-shaped strips, tiles, slates and panels), prefabricated or pre-assembled building parts (windows, doors, outdoor shutters, staircases, partition walls and gratings), houses, garages and other buildings, and miscellaneous construction elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 25-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 26 - Lighting Apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes candlesticks and candelabra; torches and hand lamps and lanterns; public lighting fixtures (outside lamps, stage lighting and light projectors); luminous sources electrical or not (bulbs, luminous plaques and tubes, candles); lamps, standard lamps, chandeliers, wall and ceiling fixtures, lampshades, reflectors, photographic and cinematographic projector lamps; luminous devices for vehicles; and miscellaneous lighting apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 26-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 27 - Tobacco and Smokers' Supplies
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes tobacco, cigars and cigarettes; pipes, cigar and cigarette holders; ashtrays; matches; lighters; cigar cases, cigarette cases, tobacco jars and pouches (not including packages Class 9); and miscellaneous smokers' supplies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 27-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 28 - Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Products, Toilet Articles and Apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: (a) Pharmaceutical products including for animals (but not materials for dressing wounds and nursing Class 24-04). (b) Cosmetic products including for animals. Includes toilet articles and beauty parlor equipment (including razors and appliances for massaging, hair removing or hair dressing; not including make-up brushes Class 4-02 or articles for animals Class 30-99), wigs and false hairpieces, and miscellaneous items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 28-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 29 - Devices and Equipment Against Fire Hazards, for Accident Prevention and for Rescue
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes devices and equipment against fire hazards (including fire extinguishers; not including fire engines Class 12-13), devices and equipment for accident prevention and for rescue (including devices and equipment for animals), and miscellaneous items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 29-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 30 - Care and Handling of Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: Not including animal foodstuffs (Class 1), or pharmaceutical and cosmetic products for animals (Class 28-01 or 28-02). Includes animal clothing (30-01), pens/cages/kennels and similar shelters (30-02; not including buildings Class 25), feeders and waterers (30-03), saddlery including collars (30-04), whips and prods (30-05), beds and nests (30-06), perches and cage attachments (30-07), markers/marks/shackles (30-08), hitching posts (30-09), and miscellaneous animal-care items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 30-99 Miscellaneous.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 31 - Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes all the products not included in the preceding classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 31-00 / 31-99 used for miscellaneous items outside previous classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical list notes
rubrics_metrics.description: In both the General List and the List according to Classes and Subclasses, the abbreviations (AM.) and (BR.) appearing in brackets after certain words denote American or British usage, as the case may be.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The numbers appearing in the right-hand column, in both lists, are merely identification numbers which are not necessarily in numerical order. Consult the alphabetical list mapping to class/subclass numbers when assigning items.
